notes: Game profiles: stretched res and pro settings for CS2 / Valorant now work with several Steam or Riot accounts on one PC - every account gets them, and the message says which (e.g. 'for 2 Steam accounts (main, alt)')
If one account's settings file is locked, the others still get set and it tells you which one and what to do
Turning stretch on while the game is running no longer half-sets it - nothing changes until you close the game
